context_of_use: research-only explanation of E2 concentration, not prescription/clinical dose optimization
note: Two is an INTERNAL minimum to request expert review, NOT an ICH/FDA number or sufficient guarantee of power; justified prospective sample-size calculation still required
threshold_warning: 10% and 5% are provisional internal engineering screening rules, NOT regulatory thresholds or assay QC tolerances, and must be set before external data access with a prospective risk/power argument
metric_rules: At each distinct heldout cohort, compare frozen simpler and complex models on participant-level paired metrics. M1 primary is prespecified early time/peak score; M2 primary is separately reported late AUC and true repeated predose. Use cluster-aware uncertainty; require positive lower benefit bound and <=5% degradation guardrails. No future observation leakage.
interval_rule: No clinical 90% coverage claim until independent subject-level empirical coverage, interval width, time/dose/assay subgroup results and uncertainty assessed; otherwise label parameters-only or hide band.
ICH_M10_boundary: M10 ±15% accuracy and CV<=15% (LLOQ ±20%/CV<=20%) for chromatography QC are not PK model prediction acceptance criteria. E2 is endogenous, QC/assay bridge/BLQ require separate assessment.
